intro: Messenger to Stormwind sees you carrying General Marcus Jonathan's initial reply back to Magistrate Solomon in Lakeshire. The town is reeling from Blackrock orc raids and gnoll incursions, but the capital's response brings cold comfort rather than troops. It highlights the growing political paralysis at the heart of the kingdom.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: While I wait for a response from the King I want you to carry this letter to Magistrate Solomon.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did the General send news? Are reinforcements on the way?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you for your time, adventurer. For your service to Lakeshire and Stormwind I reward you with these coins.
Now if you'll excuse me, I find this correspondence somewhat of a mystery. Something is amiss in our Kingdom. I fear this is the beginning of conflict, not the end.
